document.abstract: A new motion-picture duplicating film, Eastman Direct (Positive) MP Film 5360, is available for duplicating black-and-white and color prints in one step using a standard black-and-white positive process. These silver image prints may be conveniently used as work prints, musical scoring prints, and prints for other editing purposes. This new film has a fine grain direct positive emulsion which is ortho-chromatic sensitive (sensitive to blue and green light). Techniques for using this film to produce black-and-white duplicate negatives as well as work prints are described.
